title: Made this in 3 days for the Unreal MegaJam! Spend 3 days shooting and editing 8mm film while living on a snowy mountain. Cozy Season!
author: prettyfuckingfarfrom
selftext:
The theme of the competition was "Director's Cut," and I interpreted that as: Make a game that probably wouldn't be successful mainstream, but that you would love to play. Like a director watching his director's cut.

I wanted to play a game where I ran around in the snow and came back to a cabin at the end of each day, so that's what I started with. The film/photography element came pretty naturally after that.

The hardest part was nailing down character movement. The game was originally supposed to be an overhead camera game where you could bring up the camera and go into the viewfinder. Eventually I realized it'd be way better if it was third person. And once I had third person, I realized I needed first person. So I had to completely scrap the old top-down WASD movement system and make a more dynamic skeleton with smooth, dynamic movement.

It took a while but eventually settled on the movement system that's in the game now; bouncy, reactive, and satisfying. Overall I'm super happy with how it turned out! (Except for the Super 8 camera still jiggling in your hand after trying to fix it 110 times, I ran out of time and gave up)

[Click here for the whole interactive dev log](https://claude.ai/artifact/TeHpWosKfNToXSuotFfMkn)

If you want to play it, you can download it for free [HERE](https://ryanharrisonplowman.itch.io/cozy-season) (just click No Thanks on the donation page to skip it)

I'd love some feedback! And I'd also love to hear from anyone else who entered the jam!
